verses.1: The rest, brothers, pray for us, so that the word of the Lord may be proclaimed and glorified, just as it was before you.
verses.2: And we must be freed from those who are evil and deceitful people. After all, not everyone’s faith is valid.
verses.3: The Lord is faithful; He will support you and protect you from the evil one.
verses.4: We believe that in you, we can find what we must do and will also do.
verses.5: And the Lord wants you to turn your hearts towards God’s love, and towards Christ’s patience.
verses.6: We ask you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to forgive those who have always been your enemies and who have not obeyed the instructions we gave them.
verses.7: For you know how we must be imitated by them. We have not been placed among you in such a way that we could be imitated.
verses.8: We didn’t eat bread either. Instead, we worked day and night, trying to avoid being too burdened by any of this.
verses.9: Not that we do not have the right, but so that we can give you the opportunity to imitate us in our manner.
verses.10: And indeed, when we were with you, we told you this: that no one should refuse to work or to contribute.
verses.11: We hear that some people are wandering around among you, doing nothing at all; they’re just moving around, without actually doing anything productive.
verses.12: To those who are like this, we ask and urge them in the Lord Jesus Christ to eat their own bread, while they continue to work with diligence.
verses.13: You, brothers, do not begrudge each other in this matter.
verses.14: But if anyone does not listen to our words because of the letter, then let it be noted that they should not be treated as enemies, so that they may be corrected.
verses.15: And do not consider them as enemies; instead, treat them as brothers.
verses.16: And this Lord of peace will give you peace in every way, in every situation. The Lord is with you through all things.
verses.17: The handshake with Paul is a symbol that appears in every letter. That’s how I write it.
verses.18: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with you all.
